case_study_packaging.readiness_notes: Client identity, objectives, quantified $100K annual savings, and four detailed proof points are available – sufficient for a concise, numbers-driven case study.
case_study_packaging.headline: Defense technology manufacturer unlocks $100K in annual savings by centralizing travel, MRO, and IT spend
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Arotech Corporation’s two divisions purchased everything from travel to MRO supplies in silos, creating a highly fragmented supplier base, inconsistent pricing, and little visibility into roughly $36 M of annual spend. With new private-equity ownership looking to boost enterprise value, the company needed a rapid, data-driven sourcing program to capture near-term savings and build a sustainable, center-led procurement function.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: A niche defense technology manufacturer’s two divisions purchased everything from travel to MRO supplies in silos, creating a highly fragmented supplier base, inconsistent pricing, and little visibility into roughly $36 M of annual spend. With the private equity ownership group focusing on operational efficiency and margin improvement, the company needed a rapid, data-driven sourcing program to capture near-term savings and build a sustainable, center-led procurement function.
approach_summary: Analyzed $1.8 M of indirect spend across travel, IT hardware, and MRO to validate baselines despite incomplete P-card and T&E data.
Migrated car-rental and key MRO categories onto OMNIA Partners GPO contracts, securing 13–32% rate reductions without operational disruption.
Negotiated chain-wide IHG Business Edge discounts and three property-specific hotel agreements, loading all preferred rates into the Egencia booking tool.
Redirected high-volume Amazon IT hardware purchases to Connection at pre-negotiated pricing, curbing marketplace leakage.
Standardized supplier contracts and implemented a center-led travel policy, giving the client real-time spend visibility and governance going forward.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya delivered $100,069 in validated annual run-rate savings across four indirect categories and raised cumulative engagement savings to roughly $600K—achieving the client’s minimum savings guarantee and a 1.5× return on the $400K project fee. Beyond the dollars, the project put national supplier agreements, centralized booking tools, and spend dashboards in place, giving leadership a scalable procurement platform for future growth.
where_we_were_unique: Captured quick-win savings within five months by leveraging Treya’s defense-qualified GPO relationships.
Converted fragmented, low-quality spend data into actionable baselines that withstood stakeholder scrutiny.
Balanced speed with buy-in by retaining incumbent suppliers where operational continuity was critical.
Provided end-to-end implementation support—drafting contracts, routing DocuSigns, and loading negotiated rates—so savings begin the moment signatures are complete.
